mentions.name: Nordic Surf Forecast App
mentions.description: A surf forecasting app for the Nordic countries that provides finer-grained wave layers than those offered by large forecast groups, enabling surfers to estimate good waves based on local winds in very complex terrain.
mentions.problem: Wave layers presented by large forecast groups are too coarse to estimate good waves based on local winds in very complex terrain.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a Surf app for Nordic countries, the wave layers presented by the large forecast groups are too course to estimate good waves based of local winds in very complex terrain. No public demo yet.
mentions.author: octocop
